title: [BEST] Autofarm, AutoUpgrade, Autosell, ESP, AutoWin
features:
[BEST] Autofarm, AutoUpgrade, Autosell, ESP, AutoWin for Search For The Needle (Roblox). Jacob Helper v3.5.0 Farmhouse Automation Suite.

Complete automated operations and needle farm system for Search For The Needle. Dominate with high-speed automation: Auto Pick Hay with Rainbow / Normal / Only Rainbow priority modes and Smart Multi-Grab, Advanced Cow Feeding auto-sell with camera-aimed flawless auto-sell and configurable thresholds, Needle Round excavator with instant needle find and auto hand-in to the Farmer NPC, Auto Vacuum ticking, Pitchfork and TNT automation, tiered ESP glow highlights (Needle, Rainbow Hay, Normal Hay, Gems), Fullbright, auto shop purchases (Pitchfork, TNT, Drone, Vacuum, bags), permanent gem upgrades (Bag Size, Grab Grasp, Gem Value, Hay Value), character mods (Walkspeed, JumpPower, Infinite Jump, Noclip), Anti-AFK, JSON config manager, and a sleek dark Patriot UI (toggle with RightShift).

Requires a key (PandaAuth key system). Mobile friendly.
